versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service WriteDataByIdentifier (0x2E), the Dcm module shall check if the DID can be written in the current security level (see configuration parameter DcmDspDidWriteSecurityLevelRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send NRC 0x33 (Security access denied).
